name: EPIC 248769814
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 14, 11.8 solar radii and 1.65 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 5,636 parsecs away, 12 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 14, give 1.65 solar masses and 11.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 5,103 K at its surface.
